genius.notes: Existing issuerEntity Bridge Building Inc. is preserved. Sui identifies Bridge and its Open Issuance platform as USDsui issuer; BBI terms and OCC CD1365 identify BBI as the current xUSD issuer. These sources corroborate the mapping, but no USDsui-specific legal contract naming BBI was located. Bridge publicly markets USDsui/Open Issuance as GENIUS-ready, supporting issuer-announced-intent only. OCC CD1365 grants preliminary conditional approval to a separate proposed Bridge National Trust Bank sponsored by Bridge Ventures LLC, not PPSI approval for Bridge Building Inc. or USDsui. No exact USDsui issuer pathway or GENIUS application was located, so issuerPathway is unknown and OCC is not attributed as its primary GENIUS regulator. The live USDsui reserve API reports cash and Treasury holdings; this and FAQ redemption/reserve disclosures are not monthly accountant attestations. The dated negative review is limited to checked public sources. Rules remain proposed; Treasury expects January 18, 2027 effectiveness, with a separate July 18, 2028 general DASP deadline.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official PPSI application or registered foreign exception naming Bridge Building Inc. / USDsui was located in the listed sources. This is a dated public-evidence finding, not proof that no private or unindexed application exists. Bank-charter and legacy licensing tables are not comprehensive GENIUS registers; proposed rules and SCRC procedural forms do not authorize an issuer.
